mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM pending_facts WHERE kb_id = #{kbId}) AS pending, (SELECT min(created_at) FROM pending_facts WHERE kb_id = #{kbId}) AS pending_oldest, (SELECT count(*) FROM resolution_reviews WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'pending') AS duplicates, (SELECT min(created_at) FROM resolution_reviews WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'pending') AS duplicates_oldest, (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_conflicts WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'open') AS conflicts, (SELECT min(created_at) FROM fact_conflicts WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'open') AS conflicts_oldest, (SELECT count(*) FROM facts f WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND f.valid_to IS NULL AND f.valid_to_precision IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_evidence fe WHERE fe.fact_id = f.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_evidence fe JOIN chunks c ON c.id = fe.chunk_id WHERE fe.fact_id = f.id AND c.superseded_at IS NULL)) AS unconfirmed, (SELECT min(f.recorded_at) FROM facts f WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND f.valid_to IS NULL AND f.valid_to_precision IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_evidence fe WHERE fe.fact_id = f.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_evidence fe JOIN chunks c ON c.id = fe.chunk_id WHERE fe.fact_id = f.id AND c.superseded_at IS NULL)) AS unconfirmed_oldest, (SELECT count(*) FROM facts WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND invalidated_at IS NULL AND confidence < #{below} AND derived_by_rule IS NULL) AS lowconf, (SELECT min(recorded_at) FROM facts WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND invalidated_at IS NULL AND confidence < #{below} AND derived_by_rule IS NULL) AS lowconf_oldest, (SELECT count(*) FROM axiom_violations WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'open') AS violations, (SELECT min(detected_at) FROM axiom_violations WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'open') AS violations_oldest, (SELECT count(*) FROM ontology_defects WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'open') AS defects, (SELECT min(detected_at) FROM ontology_defects WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'open') AS defects_oldest, (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM phrase_bindings b WHERE b.kb_id = #{kbId} AND (b.status = 'undecided' OR (b.status = 'bound' AND b.marks IS NULL AND (b.decided_by = 'person' OR b.marks_asked_at IS NOT NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM relation_types rt WHERE rt.id = b.relation_type_id AND rt.temporal = 'state'))) UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM type_bindings WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'undecided') a) AS alignment, (SELECT min(decided_at) FROM (SELECT b.decided_at FROM phrase_bindings b WHERE b.kb_id = #{kbId} AND (b.status = 'undecided' OR (b.status = 'bound' AND b.marks IS NULL AND (b.decided_by = 'person' OR b.marks_asked_at IS NOT NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM relation_types rt WHERE rt.id = b.relation_type_id AND rt.temporal = 'state'))) UNION ALL SELECT decided_at FROM type_bindings WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'undecided') a) AS alignment_oldest, (SELECT count(*) FROM errata_actions WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'held') AS errata, (SELECT min(created_at) FROM errata_actions WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'held') AS errata_oldest

SELECT e.action, (e.actor_id IS NULL) AS automatic, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.created_at >= now() - interval '7 days') AS last_7d, count(*) AS last_30d FROM audit_events e WHERE e.kb_id = #{kbId} AND (e.action LIKE 'review.%' OR e.action LIKE 'fact.%' OR e.action LIKE 'conflict.%' OR e.action LIKE 'merge.%') AND e.created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY e.action, automatic ORDER BY last_30d DESC, e.action

SELECT e.actor_id, min(e.actor_label) AS actor_label, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.created_at >= now() - interval '7 days') AS last_7d, count(*) AS last_30d FROM audit_events e WHERE e.kb_id = #{kbId} AND (e.action LIKE 'review.%' OR e.action LIKE 'fact.%' OR e.action LIKE 'conflict.%' OR e.action LIKE 'merge.%') AND e.created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY e.actor_id ORDER BY last_30d DESC LIMIT #{topActors}

SELECT (e.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS day, count(*) AS count FROM audit_events e WHERE e.kb_id = #{kbId} AND (e.action LIKE 'review.%' OR e.action LIKE 'fact.%' OR e.action LIKE 'conflict.%' OR e.action LIKE 'merge.%') AND e.created_at >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date - #{days}::int GROUP BY day
SELECT count(*) FROM agent_decisions WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'proposed'

SELECT status, count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '7 days') AS last_7d, count(*) AS last_30d FROM agent_decisions WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY status
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jobs WHERE kind = 'govern' AND status = 'running' AND payload->>'kb_id' = #{kbId})

SELECT count(*) FROM resolution_reviews rr WHERE rr.kb_id = #{kbId} AND rr.status = 'pending' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_decisions d WHERE d.target_kind = 'review' AND d.target_id = rr.id AND d.status = 'proposed') AND rr.stage <> 'adjudicating'

SELECT count(*) AS facts, count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.confidence < #{below} AND f.derived_by_rule IS NULL) AS low_confidence, count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.valid_to IS NULL AND f.valid_to_precision IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_evidence fe WHERE fe.fact_id = f.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_evidence fe JOIN chunks c ON c.id = fe.chunk_id WHERE fe.fact_id = f.id AND c.superseded_at IS NULL)) AS unconfirmed, count(c.fact_id) AS contested FROM facts f LEFT JOIN ( SELECT old_fact_id AS fact_id FROM fact_conflicts WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'open' UNION SELECT new_fact_id AS fact_id FROM fact_conflicts WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'open' ) c ON c.fact_id = f.id WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL
